title: 菲尼克斯直接提鋰工程
summary: 以選擇性吸附提鋰為案例，研究循環工作容量、鹵水守恆與產品品質。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A selective-adsorption lithium case studies cyclic working capacity, brine conservation and product quality. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異；捕集前後鹵水鋰量的對帳；洗滌循環水與外部補水的區分
v31FocusEn: Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity; Lithium reconciliation before and after capture; Separating washing-circuit water from external makeup

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：菲尼克斯直接提鋰工程
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Fénix direct-lithium-extraction operation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」與「捕集前後鹵水鋰量的對帳」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity" and "Lithium reconciliation before and after capture": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity" is correct?
options: 吸附法的產能受吸附劑質量、有效工作容量與每日循環數共同限制；平衡容量不等於循環工作容量。
實驗室平衡吸附容量可直接乘全年時間得到工廠產量。
鋰濃度提高十倍代表鋰產量也提高十倍。
optionsEn: Adsorption output depends on sorbent mass, working capacity and cycles per day; equilibrium capacity is not cyclic working capacity.
Laboratory equilibrium capacity can be directly multiplied by annual time to obtain plant output.
Tenfold lithium concentration implies tenfold lithium production.
quiz.explanation: 吸附法的產能受吸附劑質量、有效工作容量與每日循環數共同限制；平衡容量不等於循環工作容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Adsorption output depends on sorbent mass, working capacity and cycles per day; equilibrium capacity is not cyclic working capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」如何決定「菲尼克斯直接提鋰工程」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Fénix direct-lithium-extraction operation”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「菲尼克斯直接提鋰工程」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」。吸附法的產能受吸附劑質量、有效工作容量與每日循環數共同限制；平衡容量不等於循環工作容量。競爭離子、傳質阻力與材料劣化會降低可用量，本模型只比較合成質量收支，不提供化學再生配方。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Fénix direct-lithium-extraction operation as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity. Adsorption output depends on sorbent mass, working capacity and cycles per day; equilibrium capacity is not cyclic working capacity. Competing ions, transfer resistance and aging reduce useful capacity. This synthetic mass model supplies no chemical-regeneration recipe. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以選擇性吸附提鋰為案例，研究循環工作容量、鹵水守恆與產品品質。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Project file: A selective-adsorption lithium case studies cyclic working capacity, brine conservation and product quality. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實驗室平衡吸附容量可直接乘全年時間得到工廠產量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 依「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」的模型 M = ms·q·n·r/1000，吸附捕集與循環產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model M = ms·q·n·r/1000 for "Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for adsorption capture and cycle throughput; input units: ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
options: 144 kg/d
288 kg/d
optionsEn: 144 kg/d
288 kg/d
quiz.explanation: M = ms·q·n·r/1000；代入 ms = 8000 kg sorbent、q = 15 g Li/kg sorbent working capacity、n = 3 cycles/d、r = 0.8 fraction，得 288 kg/d（吸附捕集與循環產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: M = ms·q·n·r/1000; with ms = 8000 kg sorbent, q = 15 g Li/kg sorbent working capacity, n = 3 cycles/d, r = 0.8 fraction the result is 288 kg/d (synthetic teaching example for adsorption capture and cycle throughput; input units: ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = ms·q·n·r/1000；代入 ms = 8000 kg sorbent、q = 15 g Li/kg sorbent working capacity、n = 3 cycles/d、r = 0.8 fraction，得 288 kg/d（吸附捕集與循環產能的合成教學算例；輸入單位：ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = ms·q·n·r/1000; with ms = 8000 kg sorbent, q = 15 g Li/kg sorbent working capacity, n = 3 cycles/d, r = 0.8 fraction the result is 288 kg/d (synthetic teaching example for adsorption capture and cycle throughput; input units: ms: kg sorbent; q: g Li/kg sorbent working capacity; n: cycles/d; r: fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 317 kg/d（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 317 kg/d (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 288 kg/d（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 288 kg/d (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in q with an engineering explanation.

These are not measured or operating values for this site.).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 317 kg/d（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 317 kg/d (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are explicit synthetic teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」，用合成穿透曲線積分捕集量，與吸附劑質量乘工作容量交叉核對；計入吸附、洗滌及再生所占時間。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, integrate a synthetic breakthrough curve and cross-check sorbent mass times working capacity, including adsorption, washing and regeneration times in the cycle.
quiz.explanation: 針對「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」，用合成穿透曲線積分捕集量，與吸附劑質量乘工作容量交叉核對；計入吸附、洗滌及再生所占時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, integrate a synthetic breakthrough curve and cross-check sorbent mass times working capacity, including adsorption, washing and regeneration times in the cycle. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」，用合成穿透曲線積分捕集量，與吸附劑質量乘工作容量交叉核對；計入吸附、洗滌及再生所占時間。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, integrate a synthetic breakthrough curve and cross-check sorbent mass times working capacity, including adsorption, washing and regeneration times in the cycle. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將化學選擇性、循環壽命與水耗分別記錄，不以單一回收率比較所有流程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record selectivity, cycle life and water demand separately; one recovery ratio cannot compare every flowsheet.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」情境，初次容量高而連續產能低，可能循環時間過長或工作容量衰減；比較每循環捕集量而非單次平衡測試。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, high initial capacity with low continuous output can reflect long cycles or declining working capacity; compare capture per cycle instead of one equilibrium test. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」情境，初次容量高而連續產能低，可能循環時間過長或工作容量衰減；比較每循環捕集量而非單次平衡測試。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
鋰濃度提高十倍代表鋰產量也提高十倍。
optionsEn: In the scenario of difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, high initial capacity with low continuous output can reflect long cycles or declining working capacity.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Tenfold lithium concentration implies tenfold lithium production.
quiz.explanation: 在「平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異」情境，初次容量高而連續產能低，可能循環時間過長或工作容量衰減；比較每循環捕集量而非單次平衡測試。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity, high initial capacity with low continuous output can reflect long cycles or declining working capacity; compare capture per cycle instead of one equilibrium test. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平衡容量與循環工作容量的差異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Difference between equilibrium and cyclic working capacity: failure diagnosis

steps.observation: 連結機制：這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋰濃度提高十倍代表鋰產量也提高十倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tenfold lithium concentration implies tenfold lithium production." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「捕集前後鹵水鋰量的對帳」情境，濃度升高但產量降低可能只是水分減少或回收損失；必須比較質量流而非只比較濃度。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of lithium reconciliation before and after capture, higher concentration with lower production can mean water removal or recovery loss; compare mass flow instead of concentration alone. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
